fact_reviews.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcamera:ftCamera_80076018
fact_reviews.old_value: Receives six camera-metadata floats and a scalar multiplier, writes each input component multiplied by that scalar to the corresponding output component, and returns no value. Ordinary camera initialization and refresh consume the scaled first triplet for position offsets and facing-dependent horizontal extents, initialization consumes the second triplet for vertical extents, and the Rebirth camera callback consumes the scaled vertical offset while centering its subject on the revival destination.
fact_reviews.reason: Fresh canonical body and cited consumers support the existing claim.

fact_reviews.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcamera:ftCamera_80076064
fact_reviews.old_value: Reads six floats from `fp->ft_data->x3C` and scales them by `fp->x34_scale.y`. It combines the first triplet with `fp->facing_dir` and `Stage_GetCamFixedZoom()` to write `camera_box->target_ext.h` and `facing_dir`, copies the second triplet into `target_ext.v`, copies both target extents into `ext`, constructs `pos` from `fp->cur_pos` with the scaled vertical offset added to y, copies `pos` into `bone_pos`, and sets `state` active.
fact_reviews.reason: Fresh canonical body and cited consumers support the existing claim.

fact_reviews.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcamera:ftCamera_80076064
fact_reviews.old_value: On invocation it marks the camera subject active. Facing direction exactly equal to +1 selects the right-facing arrangement and a +1 subject-facing value; any other value selects the mirrored, negated arrangement and -1. It then unconditionally synchronizes target extents with current extents and position with bone position, without changing fighter action state or timers.
fact_reviews.reason: Preserve exact facing branch and make initialization versus named update writes explicit.
